theater_event_24_10_08_002: I-It's okay, Bell... C'mon, come over here~.
theater_event_24_10_08_004:
Now he's hiding like a little bunny!
What are you going to do about this?!
theater_event_24_10_08_005:
W-Well, what was I supposed to do?!
I'm sorry, Bell!! I just...got carried away...
theater_event_24_10_08_006:
I won't ever do anything like that again,
so please forgive me~!
theater_event_24_10_08_007:
Our "Lucky Man," Bell Cranel, has been left a
hollow shell by that brutal scramble...but never
mind that, it's time for the awards!
theater_event_24_10_08_008:
And now, the "Lucky Girl" who defied all odds to
snatch the "First Fortune"—Misha Frot,
up to the stage, please!!
theater_event_24_10_08_010: Ahh... I'm so sorry, Bell. I'm so sorry, Bell...
theater_event_24_10_08_011:
Geez, quit moping over what's done!
Let's go enjoy the Alv Mountains' photo spots!
theater_event_24_10_08_012:
Some are questioning whether a Guild employee
should walk off with the prize at a Guild event,
but it was a blast, so who cares!
theater_event_24_10_08_013: Now, from Lord Ganesha, the first prize—
theater_event_24_10_08_015:
A trip to Solingen, City of Swords...
I really wanted to give it to you, to thank you
for everything...
theater_event_24_10_08_017:
—Next, the one who seized the "Second Fortune"
with a fearsome attack—the Thousand Elf!
theater_event_24_10_08_019:
...What good is a "Second Fortune" if it isn't
even a trip...?
theater_event_24_10_08_020:
Lefiya, you won it for me...
so I'm...happy. Okay?
theater_event_24_10_08_022:
Because Lefiya...
already gives me so much "fortune."
theater_event_24_10_08_026: And now, from Lord Ganesha, the second prize—
theater_event_24_10_08_029:
How long are you going to keep eating those
lumps of grease? Even you'll get fat eventually.
theater_event_24_10_08_030:
Um... I'm sure Ms. Ais will burn it all
off in the Dungeon in no time...
theater_event_24_10_08_031:
Still, who knew the "Second Fortune" prize would
be Jyaga Maru-kun? A year's supply of the New
Year's flavor... Sounds like clearance stock.
theater_event_24_10_08_034:
Lefiya... *munch munch*.
Thank you, really. And... *munch munch*.
theater_event_24_10_08_036:
Lefiya... is there anything you want to do...
or anything you want?
theater_event_24_10_08_039:
She was THAT happy about New Year's flavor
Jyaga Maru-kun, huh...
theater_event_24_10_08_040: I want "fortune" to come to Lefiya, too.
theater_event_24_10_08_042:
Why not let her spoil you?
You worked hard for Ais this time, didn't you?
theater_event_24_10_08_043:
Yeah, yeah! While you're at it, you should
do something real "New Year's"-y!
theater_event_24_10_08_044:
Something "New Year's"-y... Well, even if a trip
is out...we could go around the city...
theater_event_24_10_08_045:
I read that in the Far East, at the start of the
year, everyone visits temples called "shrines"—
they call it the "first shrine visit"...
theater_event_24_10_08_046: Orario doesn't have anything like that.
theater_event_24_10_08_047:
Oh... I know! Ms. Ais, how about we go
into the Dungeon together for the first time
this year?!
theater_event_24_10_08_049:
Yes! Not a first shrine visit, but more like...
a "first Dungeon visit."
theater_event_24_10_08_050: What's that? That's just the same as always!
theater_event_24_10_08_052:
(Even so... the first Dungeon dive of the year
feels just a little "special." With Ms. Ais...)
theater_event_24_10_08_055: Lefiya. Let's have...another good year, okay?
theater_event_24_10_08_056:
Yes!
I'm looking forward to it, too!
theater_event_25_01_01_002:
One unlike any before it—
a sin that killed those I loved.
theater_event_25_01_01_003:
A "great sin" that could destroy
the mortal world itself.
theater_event_25_01_01_004:
My softness invited it.
My shallow judgment led to it.
theater_event_25_01_01_005:
There was no excuse, no right to grieve.
The earth-shaking roar condemned me.
theater_event_25_01_01_006:
My heart cracked as I watched my followers
weep tears of blood to take "me" back,
piercing and being pierced in turn.
theater_event_25_01_01_007:
The roar of that hideous calamity
was laughing at "me."
theater_event_25_01_01_010:
I wished for it.
For a "hero."
theater_event_25_01_01_011: Not as one of the transcendent deities,
theater_event_25_01_01_012:
but like a helpless, foolish, sobbing girl
who had lost her armor of chastity.
theater_event_25_01_01_013:
With my heart laid bare, I sought "salvation" and
craved "hope." That wailing prayer became power,
wrung out and rising to the heavens.
theater_event_25_01_01_014:
Along with the "arrow" that would destroy the
mortal world, another "arrow" appeared here.
theater_event_25_01_01_015:
It pierced the sky, tore through the clouds,
shattered the earth. The calamity, by instinct,
cowered and raged.
theater_event_25_01_01_016:
Under the moonlit night, "fate" descended.
And that is "now."
theater_event_25_01_01_017:
I open my eyes in a place I was somehow
standing, and pull free the "arrow"
planted before me.
theater_event_25_01_01_018:
My heart is light. My existence, faint.
My reason, unbound. Still, I knew what I,
a mere "remnant," had to do.
theater_event_25_01_01_019:
What begins now is a "journey" in which I
myself am judged. To complete my atonement,
I must not hesitate at anything.
theater_event_25_01_01_020:
No matter what "encounters" lie ahead,
no matter what "partings" await me.
theater_event_25_01_01_021:
I seek "salvation," search for "hope,"
and long for my own "judgment."
theater_event_25_01_01_023:
Near the "Elsos Ruins,"
many Familias have gone missing.
theater_event_25_01_01_024:
An abnormal swarm of monsters.
Something is happening in that land.
theater_event_25_01_01_025:
My Familia caught wind of that, too... Ouranos.
Those "Elsos Ruins" you mentioned—if I recall...
theater_event_25_01_01_026: Yes. An "ancient monster" is sealed there.
theater_event_25_01_01_027:
It drew power from all creation, from every part
of nature in the mortal world. In that age,
no one could ever slay it,
theater_event_25_01_01_028:
so it was sealed away by the Great Spirits...
"Antares."
theater_event_25_01_01_029:
The Behemoth, king of the land, the Leviathan,
lord of the sea, and the still-living Black Dragon
plunged the world into darkness...
theater_event_25_01_01_030:
Released before those three mighty monsters
appeared—"the Scorpion of Calamity," huh?
theater_event_25_01_01_031:
Investigate at once. But do not go too deep.
If you judge it beyond you, return to Orario
immediately and call for reinforcements.
theater_event_25_01_01_032:
...Leave it to me.
I'll handle the information-gathering, as always.
theater_event_25_01_01_033:
I'm told the Artemis Familia has already been
dispatched on a separate request. If possible,
cooperate with them to handle this.
theater_event_25_01_01_034:
Artemis? Now that's reassuring.
Everyone knows the valor of her Familia.
theater_event_25_01_01_035:
Well, she might just shoot an arrow at me
for getting too close—
theater_event_25_01_01_038: Haha, fond memories of the heavens—
theater_event_25_01_01_039:
Well, the situation is what it is. If I'm needed,
I'll do my best as the "handyman," as usual.
theater_event_25_01_02_003:
Geez, why'd we have to get off the wyverns and
walk all the way here? Hauling the supplies
was a total nightmare...
theater_event_25_01_02_004:
Honestly... Taking on another troublesome
adventurer Quest...
theater_event_25_01_02_005:
It's practically a forced Mission,
so what can ya do~, Asfi~?
theater_event_25_01_02_006: Believe me, I'd have turned it down if I could.
theater_event_25_01_02_007:
...And besides, what was that black forest
spreading out around the ruins?
theater_event_25_01_02_008: It was as if...the forest was dead...
theater_event_25_01_02_010:
Lord Hermes...?
Anyway, we should start surveying the ruins...
theater_event_25_01_02_011: Leave that to Falgar. Asfi, come with me.
theater_event_25_01_02_014:
Wha...?! The ground's been gouged out,
forest and all...
theater_event_25_01_02_015: (...Yes. Far too wide, and far too deep.)
theater_event_25_01_02_016:
(As if...something with power beyond human
understanding had fallen from the sky...)
theater_event_25_01_02_024:
And that thing she's holding...
it can't be...?
theater_event_25_01_02_025:
Hermes, I have been t-a-k-e-n.
At this rate, the mortal world will perish.
theater_event_25_01_03_001: The "Arrow of Orion," summoned from the heavens...
theater_event_25_01_03_002:
And you, Artemis, a thought-form born from the
goddess's remnant left in the arrow...
theater_event_25_01_03_003:
On top of that, an ancient monster
that's swallowed a "god"...you say?
theater_event_25_01_03_004: ...Is there any proof that this story is true?
theater_event_25_01_03_007:
Deep in the ruins we entered to investigate,
the ancient calamity—"Antares"—had awakened.
theater_event_25_01_03_009:
And I myself, of all things,
was swallowed by "Antares."
theater_event_25_01_03_010:
...How did you—how did Artemis end up
swallowed? You weren't sent back?
theater_event_25_01_03_011:
I was careless.
...No, I was soft.
theater_event_25_01_03_012:
During the attack, I shielded a girl in danger...
Lante, one of my followers.
theater_event_25_01_03_014:
I thought that when the time came,
I could be a heartless goddess.
theater_event_25_01_03_015:
...But it was nothing of the sort. It seems
the mortal world has changed me a great deal.
theater_event_25_01_03_016:
Our divine authority as gods
h-a-s n-o e-f-f-e-c-t on powerful ancient monsters.
theater_event_25_01_03_017:
...So once you were taken in by Antares,
the Scorpion of Calamity, your Arcanum
can't activate.
theater_event_25_01_03_019:
Antares itself has become a "cage"
sealing you in. In that case—
theater_event_25_01_03_020:
Even being sent back to the heavens,
part of the Arcanum, is impossible...
theater_event_25_01_03_021: ...Can Artemis be rescued from inside it?
theater_event_25_01_03_023:
I, Artemis, have become "Antares" itself.
My body and soul are too eroded to tear free.
theater_event_25_01_03_025:
I know because I'm still tied to my true self
by a thread of lingering power.
theater_event_25_01_03_026:
Unless I, Artemis, swallowed at its core,
am killed... "Antares" cannot be slain.
theater_event_25_01_03_029:
An unprecedented "great sin" that could destroy
the mortal world. As a mere remnant, I must
atone for it no matter what.
theater_event_25_01_03_030:
For the children I couldn't protect,
and for the girls I killed with my own hands.
theater_event_25_01_03_032:
I know how brazen this is.
How shameless I'm being, at this point.
theater_event_25_01_03_033: But Hermes—please, lend me your strength.
theater_event_25_01_03_034:
That proud goddess is begging the likes
of me, with all due courtesy...?
theater_event_25_01_03_035:
Ridiculous. That's...unthinkable.
Stop it, Artemis. Even as a "remnant," you're...
theater_event_25_01_03_037:
Someone has to deal with this anyway. Being the
first to meet you here must be fate of some kind.
theater_event_25_01_03_039: Nah, I'm used to this sort of thing.
theater_event_25_01_03_040:
You know how the great Zeus used to work
me to the bone, don't you, Artemis?
theater_event_25_01_03_041:
Any way you slice it, I've got connections
in Orario. I'm the best fit for the job.
theater_event_25_01_03_043: So, Artemis... Please don't make that face.
theater_event_25_01_03_045:
Anyway... things are about to get busy.
You'd best rest up while you can.
theater_event_25_01_03_046:
Well then, I'll take my leave.
I've got a lot to prepare.
theater_event_25_01_03_048:
Arrange the killing of a god.
Set the stage for an ending no one wants?
theater_event_25_01_03_049:
Even for someone who draws the "short straw"...
this is way over the top.
theater_event_25_01_04_001:
—So the monster in question, the revived Antares,
can only be finished off with a "spear"?
theater_event_25_01_04_002:
Yeah. That's why Artemis came here, looking for
someone to wield the "spear." We just happened
to run into each other.
theater_event_25_01_04_004:
—Well, for now, let's do what we can.
If we're helping, there's a mountain
of work to get through, you know?
theater_event_25_01_04_005:
(Most of the members have probably figured out
that the Artemis Familia was wiped out.)
theater_event_25_01_04_006:
(Not even they'd guess Artemis is little more
than a "remnant." If Asfi learned the truth—)
theater_event_25_01_04_007:
(She'd be furious, and she'd cry. The time will
come either way. But for now...)
theater_event_25_01_04_008: ...This isn't like me. Agonizing like this.
theater_event_25_01_04_010:
...Nope, nothing at all.
More importantly, Artemis, let's leave for Orario.
theater_event_25_01_04_011: Right now? What about Asfi and the others?
theater_event_25_01_04_012: No need to tell them. Like I said, time is short.
theater_event_25_01_04_013: Well, I'll get a good scolding once I'm back~.
theater_event_25_01_04_014: Then wouldn't it be better to just explain properly?
theater_event_25_01_04_015:
I'll get scolded when I'm back either way. Men
like to put off their problems, even knowing that.
theater_event_25_01_04_016:
...When a follower speaks up to her patron god,
it's because she cares.
theater_event_25_01_04_018:
...Don't. That smile... I never once
saw it in the heavens—
theater_event_25_01_04_020:
No... Well, now that it's decided, let's ready
the wyverns. They'll have to push hard
all the way to Orario without rest.
theater_event_25_01_04_021: An ancient monster has taken Artemis—
theater_event_25_01_04_022:
A monster wielding the power of the gods...
It's hard to believe...
theater_event_25_01_04_023:
So the abnormal swarming of monsters stemmed
from "Antares" breaking its seal...
theater_event_25_01_04_024:
Yes. Now that it's swallowed Artemis, the swarm
and its corruption of nature could spread
explosively.
theater_event_25_01_04_025:
Ouranos, there's not a moment to lose. We must find
one worthy of the "arrow" and slay "Antares" fast.
theater_event_25_01_04_026:
...Can't we gods handle it ourselves?
This is clearly beyond what our children
can deal with.
theater_event_25_01_04_027:
Impossible, Ganesha. Our "power" doesn't work on
ancient monsters. You know that without asking.
theater_event_25_01_04_029:
Antares, the Scorpion of Calamity, is now a beast
that holds two of the three cards in a game
of rock-paper-scissors.
theater_event_25_01_04_030:
Since it has the Arcanum,
our followers' power is useless against it,
theater_event_25_01_04_031:
and since it's an "ancient monster,"
the Arcanum won't work on it either.
theater_event_25_01_04_032:
At worst, if the gods banded together, we could
probably hold off "Artemis's arrows."
theater_event_25_01_04_033: But we can't slay "Antares"... Is that "absolute"?
theater_event_25_01_04_034:
The only way to slay that Antares is to pierce it
with this "arrow."
theater_event_25_01_04_035:
The "Arrow of Orion" is an arrow that can kill
the goddess Artemis...
theater_event_25_01_04_036:
With the Arcanum—the only thing that works on
the Antares that swallowed me—I will destroy
it completely.
theater_event_25_01_04_037:
A calamity that carries the "contradiction"
of being both a god and a monster...
theater_event_25_01_04_038:
So you'd forcibly cancel out that "contradiction"
using its very cause—Artemis.
theater_event_25_01_04_039:
Yes. The causality of "surely killing Artemis"
will twist the very "law" that the Arcanum
has no effect.
theater_event_25_01_04_040: Orion and Artemis are two sides of life and death.
theater_event_25_01_04_041: ...Very well. We will respect Artemis's will.
theater_event_25_01_05_001:
—The greatest concern is that "Artemis's Arrow"
might fire and blow away the entire mortal world.
theater_event_25_01_05_002:
If a mighty god's arrow nears its critical point,
the Dungeon itself will be frightened. There's no
telling what it might do.
theater_event_25_01_05_004:
Or perhaps—
it might birth another monster on par with Antares.
theater_event_25_01_05_005:
Either way, if monsters start coming up to the
surface, it won't end as a minor incident.
theater_event_25_01_05_006:
Yes. If Orario, the "lid" on the Dungeon—and
Babel with it—falls, the world has no future.
theater_event_25_01_05_007:
Then concentrating our forces is dangerous...
We'll need to deploy them carefully—
theater_event_25_01_05_008: Orario's main forces will remain here.
theater_event_25_01_05_009:
Wha—? You won't send anyone to the ruins, where
the real threat is? Are you serious, Ouranos?
theater_event_25_01_05_010:
If only the "arrow" can slay Antares,
sending more fighters there is pointless.
theater_event_25_01_05_011:
Even first-tier adventurers would only add
to the casualties.
theater_event_25_01_05_012:
...Put another way, as long as the "arrow" is
fired, even a minimal force can slay "Antares."
theater_event_25_01_05_013:
A rampage in the Dungeon is the greatest threat
to the surface... There's no denying that, huh.
theater_event_25_01_05_014:
Then once we find someone to wield the "arrow,"
Artemis and I will head back to the Elsos Ruins.
theater_event_25_01_05_015: I'm counting on you for the rest.
theater_event_25_01_05_016: How will you search for the wielder?
theater_event_25_01_05_017:
We'll use the Divine Moon Festival to hold a mock
"selection ceremony." Let us pray the wielder is
found among Orario's adventurers.
theater_event_25_01_05_020:
The Divine Moon Festival is about to start
in Orario.
theater_event_25_01_05_022:
Yeah. A time-honored festival dating back to
ancient times. Not that it's all that formal now.
theater_event_25_01_05_024:
And that's where we'll find the wielder of the
"arrow"—your "Orion."
theater_event_25_01_05_025:
Artemis, given the arrow's nature, you and its
wielder will have to connect, heart to heart,
for it to show its true power.
theater_event_25_01_05_028:
You'll need to deepen your bond with the wielder
as much as you can.
theater_event_25_01_05_029:
Otherwise, the arrow's power won't awaken,
and you'll never pierce "Antares."
theater_event_25_01_05_030: I see... No, of course. You're right.
theater_event_25_01_05_031:
If the wielder's the same sex, friendship or
affection. If not... well, the quickest route
would be romance.
theater_event_25_01_05_032: You mean love between a man and a woman?
theater_event_25_01_05_033: It doesn't have to be love. A "crush" is plenty.
theater_event_25_01_05_034:
It's the same thing, Hermes. Have you forgotten
what I preside over? I have never once had a...
theater_event_25_01_05_035: Then—shall I teach you what a "crush" is?
theater_event_25_01_05_036: No, I'll pass. I am the goddess of chastity.
theater_event_25_01_05_037:
Even with a mission I must accomplish, Hermes,
I cannot allow myself to lean on your kindness.
theater_event_25_01_05_038: I feel I must find the answer on my own.
theater_event_25_01_05_040:
Then let me support you as best I can.
I can at least give you some advice.
theater_event_25_01_05_041:
Thank you, Hermes.
...Now, I'll take my leave.
theater_event_25_01_05_042:
(One of the proud virgin goddesses—chaste and
sublime, who stole the eyes and hearts of so
many male gods.)
theater_event_25_01_05_043:
(Even as a "remnant," the shadow of her former
self hasn't faded, has it? And besides—)
theater_event_25_01_05_045:
I'm not even allowed to write it off as a stage
prop. Honestly... what a lousy role to play.
theater_event_25_01_06_001:
This next part's for advanced students. First,
you corner the target against a wall.
theater_event_25_01_06_003:
Then you slam your hand on the wall—BAM!
And tilt their chin up—like so!
theater_event_25_01_06_004:
My word! The children of the mortal world
have such a culture...
theater_event_25_01_06_005:
Wall slam... chin tilt... It's no use,
I don't understand... What am I supposed
to do... Ugh...
theater_event_25_01_06_006:
Hermes... I simply can't act like Aphrodite,
the goddess of love. Just remembering her
makes me nauseous...
theater_event_25_01_06_007:
You don't need to become Aphrodite.
Just use her—a professional at romance—
as a little reference—
theater_event_25_01_06_009:
The goddess of beauty, invincible and supreme!
Aphrodite is none other than me!
theater_event_25_01_06_011:
—Even that's too much. Just trying to copy a single
move of Aphrodite's makes me break out in hives!
theater_event_25_01_06_012:
Something dark that must never be unleashed is
welling up inside me! I can't even think about
bonding with the wielder!
theater_event_25_01_06_013:
Artemis.
Aphrodite was jealous of you, you know.
theater_event_25_01_06_015:
It's true. Never swayed by any man, strong,
dignified...
theater_event_25_01_06_016:
Aphrodite envied you—serene as the moon,
her complete opposite.
theater_event_25_01_06_018:
You think? She let it slip to me once
when she was drunk.
theater_event_25_01_06_019:
"That girl's a childish, inflexible little thing
without a speck of dirt on her. When she falls
in love, I bet—
theater_event_25_01_06_020:
it'll be a love so pure and beautiful that even
I, a goddess of beauty, will be jealous and
starstruck"—she said.
theater_event_25_01_06_022:
Aphrodite never truly hated you from the bottom
of her heart. As a fellow goddess, she was
rooting for your love—
theater_event_25_01_06_024:
If what you say is true... Aphrodite is a
troublesome goddess.
theater_event_25_01_06_025:
Aphrodite's the heavens' reigning queen
of tsundere, after all~.
theater_event_25_01_06_026:
Very well. Hermes, I'll go along with your
sweet talk.
theater_event_25_01_06_027:
I'll try, at least a little, to approach this
"love" Aphrodite spoke of.
theater_event_25_01_06_029: But if I can't, there's nothing to be done.
theater_event_25_01_06_030:
I know. I'm not forcing anything.
As Lady Artemis wills it, as they say.
theater_event_25_01_06_031:
—It's not enough. A setup like this can't bring
even a sliver of hope to the worst of fates.
theater_event_25_01_06_032:
For that, I'll use selfish "wishes," ugly
"sophistry." Whatever it takes to sow
a single "seed"—
theater_event_25_01_06_033:
—Promise me, Artemis. When the wielder of the
"arrow" appears, you'll face them, no matter what.
theater_event_25_01_06_034:
...Even if it means forcing a terrible burden
on them?
theater_event_25_01_06_036:
Even if, to an onlooker, it looks like
I'm using them?
theater_event_25_01_06_038:
...Then perhaps it would be better if I kept
my distance, as a "sinner"...
theater_event_25_01_06_041:
But you mustn't act only to condemn yourself,
only for the sake of atonement.
theater_event_25_01_06_042:
No arrow powered by that would ever work on
"Antares." It wouldn't hold your truth.
theater_event_25_01_06_043:
Until the very moment you vanish, you have to
make the time you spend "real."
theater_event_25_01_06_044:
You have to leave behind proof that you
were here.
theater_event_25_01_06_045:
At least let those final moments become
"something that saves her"—
theater_event_25_01_06_046:
That wish is just me pushing everything onto the
wielder. Shallow ego. I know that.
theater_event_25_01_06_048:
Living a "lie" because you'll vanish anyway...
wouldn't that be an insult to the mortal world
you love?
theater_event_25_01_06_049:
You, no more than an innocent, newborn girl,
couldn't resist pretty words wrapped up
in this kind of truth.
theater_event_25_01_06_050:
After a moment's hesitation,
you nodded with a sad smile.
theater_event_25_01_06_051:
Very well... I will stand by my fate with the
wielder of the Arrow of Orion—"Orion"
himself—until the very end.
theater_event_25_01_06_052:
—"Orion," whom I've yet to meet.
Curse me all you like for building
such a cruel stage.
theater_event_25_01_06_053:
But at least... for her, born only to vanish,
please, if only for a moment—
theater_event_25_01_07_001:
...Say, Hermes.
What sort of child do you think "Orion" is?
theater_event_25_01_07_002:
What race, even? A human? A beastman?
An elf? A Prum—
theater_event_25_01_07_003:
Perhaps an Amazon... Maybe even a woman,
like me...?
theater_event_25_01_07_004:
That's certainly possible.
Can't stop thinking about it already, huh?
theater_event_25_01_07_005:
Yes... What will their voice sound like? How
will they laugh? When we meet...how will
I be able to act around them?
theater_event_25_01_07_006:
You got me all worked up,
and once I started thinking about it...well.
theater_event_25_01_07_007:
The festival is still days away, yet I find myself
wandering the city every night, looking for
the wielder.
theater_event_25_01_07_009:
Surprisingly, no.
But my chest feels all fluttery...I can't settle.
theater_event_25_01_07_010:
Then there's no problem. If anything,
it's a good sign.
theater_event_25_01_07_011:
That feeling of longing for fate, of wishing for
it, will surely drive you to connect with "Orion."
theater_event_25_01_07_013:
...My Familia's children once told me
that "love" is a wonderful thing.
theater_event_25_01_07_015:
Maybe ever since that day, I've wanted to know
the "unknown" that chastity has never known...
the thing called "love."
theater_event_25_01_07_016:
It's the mortal world's unknown that so many gods
come down to see, but hearing it from you
feels fresh.
theater_event_25_01_07_017:
Then just as you are, let's wait for "Orion"—
like a girl yearning for love. Let's wait for
the day of destiny, shall we?
theater_event_25_01_07_018: The day of the Divine Moon Festival—
theater_event_25_01_07_019: Artemis, what are you doing out here?
theater_event_25_01_07_020: Hermes, what are those children doing over there?
theater_event_25_01_07_023: Most of them are couples, after all.
theater_event_25_01_07_024: I see... So they are "in love."
theater_event_25_01_07_026:
—Sorry. Let's go back.
Believing we'll meet the one we're waiting for.
theater_event_25_01_07_033:
Wh-wh-wh-wh-wha-wha-wha-wha-whaaa?!
What the heck is thaaaaaat?!!
theater_event_25_01_07_034:
On this day, the boy chosen by fate truly met
the goddess who had descended on a moonlit night.
theater_event_25_01_07_035: —Now, let the "Tale of the Promise" begin.
theater_event_25_01_07_036:
Even if this story is bound to end
in nothing but tragedy—
theater_event_25_01_07_037:
I, as the "Storyteller," will stand beside your
"fate"—and beside your "sin."
theater_event_25_01_08_001: —The plan went off without a hitch.
theater_event_25_01_08_002:
Just as arranged with Ouranos and the others, the
party selected to wield the "arrow"—
theater_event_25_01_08_003:
Bell, along with Hestia, little Lili, and Welf—
left Orario without delay.
theater_event_25_01_08_004:
I kept Artemis and "Orion" together as much as I
could, so nothing would get in their way.
theater_event_25_01_08_005:
Yes... Until the unavoidable final moment came,
this journey must not be a tragic one.
theater_event_25_01_08_006:
A dreamlike escape from the everyday, one unknown
after another. If only that journey could be
one "that never fades"—
theater_event_25_01_08_007: I fulfilled my duty as the god of travelers.
theater_event_25_01_08_009:
Hmm, why not start by giving "Orion"
a big hug?
theater_event_25_01_08_012: How can I connect my heart with Orion's?
theater_event_25_01_08_013: Feeding him "say ahh" style is another option.
theater_event_25_01_08_017:
Between legs of the journey, Artemis came to me
for advice at every turn.
theater_event_25_01_08_018:
With her innocent naivety, Artemis put my sly
advice into practice one after another, closing
the distance with Bell—
theater_event_25_01_08_020:
From duty to slay a monster, to words and deeds
from deep in her heart for "Orion." Artemis
herself was changing, too.
theater_event_25_01_08_022:
...Maybe you really are "Orion," the one who
pierces.
theater_event_25_01_08_023: Huh, what was that, Lord Hermes?
theater_event_25_01_08_026:
The enemy's "arrow" is nearing completion
faster than we gods expected.
theater_event_25_01_08_027:
Yes. There's no time to spare. Once we regroup
with Asfi and the others, we'll storm the ruins.
theater_event_25_01_08_028: ...It's not as if we have no options.
theater_event_25_01_08_029:
If we gods joined forces, we might be able
to rescue you from "Antares."
theater_event_25_01_08_031:
If so, I should have proposed it before the journey
began, before the "arrow" chose its wielder.
theater_event_25_01_08_032:
I should have acted on it then.
So why bring it up now?
theater_event_25_01_08_033:
If we shatter the "arrow" in the sky, we can buy
time. Maybe we'll find a breakthrough meanwhile.
theater_event_25_01_08_034: Have I gone soft on her...? Me?
theater_event_25_01_08_035:
Over that valiant moon goddess? Just because
the goddess smiled like a "girl"—?
theater_event_25_01_08_037:
And if I'm saved, how many gods will be
sacrificed?
theater_event_25_01_08_039:
What will become of this world after using the
Arcanum again and again? Of the children who
live on this land?
theater_event_25_01_08_041:
And how much of a chance is there that I could
even be saved?
theater_event_25_01_08_042: It's simple math. I alone should be the sacrifice.
theater_event_25_01_08_044:
That the chance of saving this "girl"
was zero. As good as zero.
theater_event_25_01_08_045:
It was my sin to begin with... If I hadn't failed,
none of this would have happened.
theater_event_25_01_08_047:
Hermes... I told you. I committed a "sin."
This is the retribution I must accept.
theater_event_25_01_08_050: Thank you, Hermes. For thinking of me.
theater_event_25_01_08_051:
...Your resolve seems firm.
Sorry for testing you like that.
theater_event_25_01_08_052: It's all right. I don't mind.
theater_event_25_01_08_053:
As promised, I'll support you to the very end.
I'll watch over you until you atone for your sin.
theater_event_25_01_08_055:
...C'mon now, I'm Hermes, remember?
Let's not get all sentimental. It's not like me...
theater_event_25_01_08_056:
Guess I'm in no position to give Hestia
a hard time either...
theater_event_25_01_08_058:
Just like always, I'll keep putting you
through "trials."
theater_event_25_01_08_059:
Once you know what I've done, you'll resent me.
Hate me. That's fine. Curse me all you want.
theater_event_25_01_08_060:
But just this once. Just this once, when the worst
trial imaginable lies in wait—
theater_event_25_01_09_002:
We reached the "Forest of Death,"
and the brutal battle began—
theater_event_25_01_09_003:
In the ruins, a cruel truth was laid bare
before the young ones.
theater_event_25_01_09_005: The young smith—Welf—bit down on his helplessness.
theater_event_25_01_09_007:
The Perseus, Asfi, asked me whether the
"great sin of killing a god" was right.
theater_event_25_01_09_009: And the boy—Bell—howled, and broke down.
theater_event_25_01_09_013: This isn't a story about killing a goddess...
theater_event_25_01_09_014: It's a story about you saving a girl who's crying.
theater_event_25_01_09_017:
Not sent back—everything vanishes, everything
is purified. The last radiance of "her" soul—
lights up all around.
theater_event_25_01_09_019:
The false moon vanished, the black calamity was
slain, and a single boy committed a "great sin"—
theater_event_25_01_09_020: The fateful day when one goddess was saved.
theater_event_25_01_09_021: A blessing of light covered the world.
theater_event_25_01_09_022:
Surely...that falling snow of pure light was the
girl's final selfish wish. A beautiful miracle
of light to heal the ravaged world.
theater_event_25_01_09_023:
And at the same time...it must have been her
way of saying "thank you" to a single boy.
theater_event_25_01_09_024:
I—kept gazing at the last pillar of my kin,
rising into the heavens.
theater_event_25_01_09_026:
The aftercare's handled, too. I swear it on my
name as the multitalented god.
theater_event_25_01_09_027: Artemis... You certainly did commit a "sin."
theater_event_25_01_09_028:
But you didn't run from it. You faced it, and
stood up to it to settle everything.
theater_event_25_01_09_029:
You knew you'd hurt the one who pierces—Orion—
and you wept yourself, yet you never once
stopped moving forward.
theater_event_25_01_09_030:
Even if the world never forgives you...
I, at least, will absolve your sin.
theater_event_25_01_09_031:
Sorry to borrow Hestia's words, but you
kept me on my toes the whole time.
theater_event_25_01_09_032:
Ahh, honestly... The finer the woman,
the more she toys with me.
theater_event_25_01_09_033:
Dear Artemis... When your "soul" returns again,
I will surely bring you to "the one you wait for."
theater_event_25_01_09_036:
A hundred years from now? A thousand?
Or maybe ten thousand?
theater_event_25_01_09_037:
So that someday, under the same sky,
you two can meet again.
theater_event_25_01_09_038:
On the name of Hermes, I will fulfill this
contract. I mean, isn't that right?
theater_event_25_01_09_039:
The "Tale of the Promise," spun by the boy chosen
by fate and the goddess who descended on a
moonlit night, isn't over yet—
theater_event_25_01_09_040: That's right—because I'm Hermes, after all.
theater_event_25_02_01_004:
Gwahahaha!!
You think power like that can crush us?!
theater_event_25_02_01_005:
That's not true!
As long as we have strong hearts that believe—
theater_event_25_02_01_008:
"The Adventures of Garrard" is about a knight
who dives into a labyrinth to heal a princess
with an incurable illness!
theater_event_25_02_01_009:
No matter what monster shows up, no sweat! Garrard
blazing through the labyrinth is soooo cool!
theater_event_25_02_01_010:
"Aladin the Mage" is about a mage who sets out

theater_event_25_02_01_011:
He gets caught up in all kinds of schemes, but

That was fun!
theater_event_25_02_01_013:
I read tons back in Telskyura, the Land of

theater_event_25_02_01_014:
Mmm, bookstores are just the best!

theater_event_25_02_01_016:
Yeah! So many stories... So many "worlds"

still tons more!
theater_event_25_02_01_017:
There are still tons of stories here I've never

theater_event_25_02_01_020:
It's been a while, and I kinda want to

theater_event_25_02_01_022: Oh, you want this one too?
theater_event_25_02_01_024:
"Argonaut" is great, huh~? No matter how many

theater_event_25_02_01_026:
Right~?
Here, go ahead! I've read it a bunch already.
theater_event_25_02_01_027:
—No need to give it up, miss.
She's not going to buy it anyway.
theater_event_25_02_01_029:
She's a habitual browser. She comes here every
chance she gets and reads from morning till
night without buying a single book...
theater_event_25_02_01_030:
Go on, shoo. You're bad for business.
If you're not buying, go somewhere else.
theater_event_25_02_01_033:
She's an orphan living on Daedalus Street,
so I've turned a blind eye to some extent
out of pity, but...
theater_event_25_02_01_034:
I've got a business to run, too.
More importantly, did anything catch your eye?
theater_event_25_02_01_036:
—Ais, you're stopping by Lord Goibniu's
place after this, right?
theater_event_25_02_01_037: Yeah. I need to...pick up my sword.
theater_event_25_02_01_038:
Then I'll go find that girl before heading home.
I want to give her this.
theater_event_25_02_01_040:
Yep! When I was little...

theater_event_25_02_01_041:
I want her to feel that way too!
I'm gonna go give her a present!
theater_event_25_02_01_042:
See ya later! I wonder if she's

—I'm looking for a girl who's always at the

theater_event_25_02_01_044:
Ah... Could you mean...

Nope! Hey, can you tell me where

theater_event_25_02_01_049: Ummm. He said she'd be around here...

Hiya again!

Waaaaaaaah!!

theater_event_25_02_02_097:

Well, small as she is, she's prob'ly got

...?! Worries... So that means she really wants

I... I just...

Daedalus Street—a real Dungeon up on the

I wanna see this girl you're so hung up on

theater_event_25_02_03_143:

I guarantee it!
theater_event_25_02_03_154:
Liar...! There was a girl who got tricked
like that and sold off to the Pleasure Quarter!
theater_event_25_02_03_155:
Stupid fantasies like these...don't mean anything!
I can't make everyone smile like Argonaut can!
theater_event_25_02_03_157: Ahh~, guess I pushed a bit too hard~...
theater_event_25_02_03_161:
Tiona, ya want that kid to smile and make up
magical girl stories... That right?
theater_event_25_02_03_162:
Huh... Y-yeah.
If she did, I'd be happy, and I'd get to
hear lots of stories, too...
theater_event_25_02_03_163:
In that case, leave it ta me.
I got a great "plan"—!
theater_event_25_02_04_164:
Having overcome the spirits' trials, fierce as
a storm, I have reached the summit of heroes!
Now, grant me the power of the great gods!
theater_event_25_02_04_165:
—Wh-what's with all the shouting? Tiona and Loki
have been up to something lately...
theater_event_25_02_04_166:
Who knows?
Probably scheming something stupid.
theater_event_25_02_04_167:
Is it...going to be okay? Looks like they've got
Gareth and Ms. Ais doing something, too...
theater_event_25_02_04_168: Well, the captain's leaving them be. It's fine.
theater_event_25_02_04_169:
Tiona! No! Passion alone won't cut it!
With this kinda thing, if it ain't cute,
it ain't justice!
theater_event_25_02_04_170:
Sweeter! More heartfelt!
More wonderful! Show me, Tiona!
theater_event_25_02_04_172: ...Is this really going to be okay?
theater_event_25_02_04_173:
Uh... Probably?
Beats watching that idiot stew and stall, anyway.
theater_event_25_02_04_175:
Yup. Everything's set up.
The rest is up ta you lot—well? Ya ready?
theater_event_25_02_04_176:
You bet! I'll get it through to her...
Our feelings, and the magic of miracles!
theater_event_25_02_04_177:
Damn it all...
Why the hell am I doing this stupid crap...
theater_event_25_02_04_178:
Gwahaha! It's for a little girl's dream!
You lost a drinking contest to Loki and me,
so quit grumbling and do as you're told!
theater_event_25_02_04_181:
And how the hell did YOU get bought off
so easy?!
theater_event_25_02_04_182:
All right! The lineup's perfect!
Everyone do it just like I told ya!
theater_event_25_02_04_183: Let's do our best! Hip, hip, hooray!!
theater_event_25_02_04_185:
Heh heh, just you wait, Sensei!
I'll make ya admit that ridiculous talent
of yours if it kills me!
theater_event_25_02_04_186:
I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
I won't do it again!
theater_event_25_02_04_187:
No... That's it. Today you knocked over the dye
vat and ruined the whole batch...
theater_event_25_02_04_188:
If you're gonna space out like that on the job,
I can't get any work done.
theater_event_25_02_04_190: ...Sorry, but go find work somewhere else.
theater_event_25_02_04_192:
I did it again...
Even though I said I'd stop. Why...?
theater_event_25_02_04_193:
Just... get out!
Magical girls... get out of my heart!!
theater_event_25_02_04_194:
Kukuku... What a fine, rich "dream" this is.
As a first step toward ending the world,
I'll suck it dry!
theater_event_25_02_04_196:
I am Elgarm, dark apostle sent from the Land
of Darkness! Now, come here! Hand over your
"dream"!
theater_event_25_02_04_198:
Wahahahaha! You won't escape!
Give up now, be stained by darkness,
and despair!
theater_event_25_02_04_199:
H-how... Why...
is there a dark apostle...?
theater_event_25_02_04_200:
Hold iiiiiiit!
Elgarm, keep your hands off that girl!!
theater_event_25_02_05_202:
It's dangerous, so stay back.
Don't worry, I'll protect you, no matter what!
theater_event_25_02_05_204: —What are you? Out of my way!
theater_event_25_02_05_205: No way! I won't let you steal her "dream"!
theater_event_25_02_05_207:
Wahahahaha! Our power of darkness is invincible!!
As if I'd lose to small fry without the
blessing of light!
theater_event_25_02_05_210:
Yeah!
But at this rate, I can't beat him—
theater_event_25_02_05_211:
—Please. Lend me your power!
Put your wish into this brooch! Your magic!
theater_event_25_02_05_212:
That's... the transformation brooch I made up?!
But that's just a made-up story...
theater_event_25_02_05_213:
Please! With you, I know we can make a miracle
happen! So, just like the fairies of the
Land of Light did...!
theater_event_25_02_05_214:
Gahaha, a miracle? Don't make me laugh!
I'll devour both your "dreams" right now!
theater_event_25_02_05_215:
I believe in it! The magic you drew is a light
that makes miracles—just like Argonaut!
theater_event_25_02_05_217:
It's okay if you can't believe in yourself yet.
But just once! Just once, please go along
with my selfish wish!
theater_event_25_02_05_222:
Eheheh!!
All riiight, here we goooooo!!
theater_event_25_02_05_223:
—I'll cast a spell of smiles☆!
Magical Change, Sunny Smile!!
theater_event_25_02_05_224:
Wh-what?! A magical girl...of light?!
This is... the legendary...
theater_event_25_02_05_226:
It's your dream, but it's not a dream!
I'm Sunny Smile! And I'm right here!
theater_event_25_02_05_227:
The pretty, smiley magical girl who protects
everyone! I'll even make that dark apostle smile!
theater_event_25_02_05_228:
The only time I smile is when I see your faces
sunk in despair! Come at me! I'll suck your
"dream" dry, too!
theater_event_25_02_05_229:
—Ngh?! This power?!
It's the Queen of Light, Big Mother's...!
theater_event_25_02_05_230:
That's right!
Mother is always protecting us!
theater_event_25_02_05_232:
She lost her parents in the Dark Era and survived
alone on Daedalus Street. A life way too harsh
for that tiny back to carry—
theater_event_25_02_05_233:
That's what gave birth to her desperate wish. It's
all in the "magical girl" she created. That's why
it resonates! Why it shines!
theater_event_25_02_05_234:
Tiona, keep it up! Show Sensei...
just how amazing the thing she made is!
theater_event_25_02_05_235:
...Um... As you asked, I explained to the people
around here that this is a show...
theater_event_25_02_05_236:
Thanks for your trouble. Now we won't bother the
locals. Go all out, do whatever ya want!
theater_event_25_02_05_237:
—Look at that. That's the new image of a hero,
made by you, Perseus, and a rare genius!
theater_event_25_02_05_238:
Um... I haven't slept in days, making that
"transformation brooch"...
theater_event_25_02_05_239:
Now, now, don't be like that. Hermes was totally
pumped and all in once he heard "Sunday mornin',"
wasn't he?
theater_event_25_02_05_240: I don't understand any of this at all...
theater_event_25_02_05_241:
—Curses! Don't get cocky, Sunny Smile!
Even with Big Mother's power,
you're no match for us!
theater_event_25_02_05_242:
Come forth, dark apostle Vanargand!
Tear apart every dream, every foolish hope!
theater_event_25_02_05_243:
Shut up...
And why are you so into this, old man...?
theater_event_25_02_06_244: I... I am the dark apostle, Vanargand...
theater_event_25_02_06_245:
Come on! Put some pride into it!
With that attitude, you'll never beat
a magical girl!
theater_event_25_02_06_247:
—Yeah! I'm the dark apostle Vanargand!!
I'll rip your so-called "dream" to shreds!
theater_event_25_02_06_248:
Oh my~, so Vanargand does acting like that!
Found his playful side~! How cuuute~.
theater_event_25_02_06_250: ...Why am I in this damn sideshow...
theater_event_25_02_06_251:
Heh. When I heard it was a show for a child,
I wondered why I'd been cast as the villain—
theater_event_25_02_06_252:
But look at that.
Our work wasn't for nothing.
theater_event_25_02_06_253:
Amazing... A dark apostle... Even a wolfman,
for real... This is...my magical girl...
theater_event_25_02_06_255:
...I'll crush you, magical girl!
Vanargand's fangs tear every hope apart!
theater_event_25_02_06_257:
Gwahahaha! Two against one!
We'll crush you right here!!
theater_event_25_02_06_261:
...I'm okay. As long as we have strong hearts
that believe, magical girls never lose—right?
theater_event_25_02_06_264:
—Hey, hey. Tell me more about magical girls!
So, what's the second magical girl like...
theater_event_25_02_06_265:
How many times do I have to tell you?!
It doesn't mean anything! It's pointless!
theater_event_25_02_06_266: I'm going to...become a proper grown-up...
theater_event_25_02_06_267:
But I really, really wanna know.
About your...magical girls.
theater_event_25_02_06_269:
'Cause I love them! They get me excited.
Seeing all the "worlds" drawn here.
theater_event_25_02_06_271:
...Fine, you can have this.
It's all written in here. Just don't talk to me
anymore.
theater_event_25_02_06_273:
I've been drawing everything I thought up since
I was little. But I don't need it anymore—
theater_event_25_02_06_274:
What's wrong, what's wrong?! Is that all?!
Throw away your stupid "dream" already!
theater_event_25_02_06_275:
—I won't! As long as we have strong hearts
that believe, magical girls never lose!!
theater_event_25_02_06_276:
That famous line was written over and over in the
notebook I borrowed from Sensei. It's what she
really feels, deep down—
theater_event_25_02_06_277:
A lingering attachment she just can't let go of...
All this time, Sensei wanted to shout that she'd
draw her dreams and march on, no matter what.
theater_event_25_02_06_278:
And the Amazon is giving it shape...
That girl's...cry from the heart...
theater_event_25_02_06_280:
Yup. She's glued to it.
Just one more push. Go get 'em, everyone—
theater_event_25_02_06_282: She's still got this much power left?! Damn it!
theater_event_25_02_06_283:
But the tide is still ours! The world will be
dyed in darkness eventually! Let's wear her
down and crush her!
theater_event_25_02_06_284:
Hmph! Mother left more than one light behind!
Please—help me, Lovely Blue!!
theater_event_25_02_06_290:
The power of love is infinite.
Magical Change, Lovely Blue.
theater_event_25_02_06_294:
What the...? They said they were doing a play,
but the Sword Princess and the Amazon are in
weird outfits...
theater_event_25_02_06_295:
But... It's my first time seeing it, yet somehow
it feels nostalgic... What is this strange
feeling...?
theater_event_25_02_06_296:
All right! Now we're cookin'...!
Keep chargin' right to the end, you two!!
theater_event_25_02_07_300:
Guoooooooooh!!
What is this power?! So hot... So strong!!
theater_event_25_02_07_301:
This is the power of the "dreams" of children who
kept wishing for the future, driven by
overflowing feelings!
theater_event_25_02_07_302:
Someday those wishes will come true, become
a light as bright as the sun, and light up
any darkness!
theater_event_25_02_07_303:
So no matter what despair stands in our way...
magical girls never lose. We can't lose.
theater_event_25_02_07_304:
Shut up! Nobody needs that crap!! Give up on your
stupid dreams and just do whatever the grown-ups
tell you!
theater_event_25_02_07_306:
Go for iiiiiiit!
Don't lose, magical giiiiirls!!
theater_event_25_02_07_308:
Love, rain down! Smiles, burst forth!
Lovely Smile—
theater_event_25_02_07_309:
Huh?!
W-why did our transformation wear off...?!
theater_event_25_02_07_310: Hey, hey! What's goin' on here?!
theater_event_25_02_07_311:
Could it be... Even if it was acting, the fierce
battle between first-tier adventurers broke
the "transformation brooches"...?
theater_event_25_02_07_312:
Bad... This is bad. We're right at the finale.
If it don't end with 'em as magical girls,
the whole thing's pointless...
theater_event_25_02_07_313: Worse yet, if it ends half-baked like this...
theater_event_25_02_07_316:
No good. At this rate, everything we've built
up'll turn into a farce. She'll think "magical
girls" are just a lie...
theater_event_25_02_07_317:
(No... I can't let her see me in despair...!
At a time like this... What would Argonaut do...!)
theater_event_25_02_07_318:
—You dark apostles! How dare you!
Sealing the magical girls' power
with the power of darkness!
theater_event_25_02_07_319:
Hmm—Gwahahaha! This is the power of our darkness!
The tables have turned, little girls!
theater_event_25_02_07_320:
Lovely Blue—hold them off for a sec, please!
I'll figure something out!
theater_event_25_02_07_323:
Well?! Can the "transformation brooches"
be fixed?!
theater_event_25_02_07_324:
It'll take a little time,
but I can fix them.
theater_event_25_02_07_326:
But what're we gonna do? If it takes time,
there's no way we can keep this goin'—
theater_event_25_02_07_327: Take that! Feel this, Lovely Blue!
theater_event_25_02_07_330:
Sensei was glued to the show a second ago,
and now she looks worried...
theater_event_25_02_07_331:
Ugh, Argonaut would pull off some amazing
comeback even in a pinch like this...!
theater_event_25_02_07_332:
I can't think of anything~!
What do I do? At this rate—
theater_event_25_02_07_333:
Ah-hahaha! What are you all spacing out for?!
Let's crush those little girls right now!
theater_event_25_02_07_335:
The serpent venom of Jormungand, dark apostle,
will plunge you magical girls into the depths
of despair!!
